definitions.explanation: A person's build as it strikes others, almost always in {恰幅|かっぷく}がいい / {恰幅|かっぷく}のいい: well-built and solid, a little heavy, with a dignified air. A polite way to describe a portly middle-aged man.

examples.japanese: {恰幅|かっぷく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a portly, well-built man.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{恰幅|かっぷく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よくて⟦{貫禄|かんろく}→貫禄：10570_kanroku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The president is solidly built and has real presence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{痩|や}せていた→痩せる：01146_yaseru⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧{恰幅|かっぷく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My father, once thin, has filled out with age.

notes:
Nearly always positive or tactful: {恰幅|かっぷく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ says "stout" without saying "fat" (⟦{太|ふと}っている→太る：01190_futoru⟧), and suggests dignity. Used mostly of men.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恰幅|かっぷく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: well-built, portly
- {恰幅|かっぷく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{紳士|しんし}→紳士：18022_shinshi⟧: a portly gentleman
- {恰幅|かっぷく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to fill out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧: physique, build — neutral, of anyone
- ⟦{貫禄|かんろく}→貫禄：10570_kanroku⟧: presence, gravitas — often goes with {恰幅|かっぷく}
- ⟦{太|ふと}っている→太る：01190_futoru⟧: fat — blunt
